properties.notes: WP/15/0092/FUL - Erection of a terrace of five 2-storey houses with room in the roof and associated works. WP/15/00094/FUL - Conversion of upper floor to 5 self-contained residential units and the change of use of ground floor from D2 use class to D1 use class (non-residential Community Centre). Associated external alterations to the building. WP/16/00682/FUL - Conversion of ground and lower floors of former Working Mens Club to form four two-bed and one one-bed flats. ADDITIONAL BIN STORAGE (this permission partially supersedes WP/15/00094/FUL). The five dwelling units pursuant to WP/15/00092/FUL were completed in June 2016 and are located at the rear of the working mens club. The 5 self-contained residential units pursuant to WP/15/00094/FUL were completed in September 2016. Works relating to WP/16/00682/FUL commenced in August 2017.
